name: errance
description: Public transport journeys, departures and maps powered by open data

interface.longDescription:
Errance helps you get around by public transport, wherever open transport data is available through Transitous. Plan journeys between two places and compare itineraries on a map, including walking sections, transfers and available real-time delay information.

Check upcoming departures from any stop, follow a journey stop by stop, and explore nearby lines and stops. Discover shared bikes, scooters and cars nearby, and find out how far you can travel within a given time.

Errance uses open transport data from local transport agencies and mobility providers, aggregated by Transitous through GTFS, GTFS-RT and GBFS feeds. Data coverage and real-time information depend on what is published by these providers. No account is required.
capabilities: Show the next departures of a stop
Follow a trip stop by stop
Explore the lines and stops of an area
Find shared bikes, scooters and cars
Show how far you can travel in a given time
